question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

solution:
The logic here followed is: 

Two different series is followed. Step 1 and step 3 are followed the same pattern. And step 2 and step 4 are followed the same pattern.

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b7ea831554b81ccddad0c13dbe679c6e53dce0807ae845913cd2fa03013fbb4.png] 

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76469d5e8f86dd3df6b96ccad6e7b2976bfda7cbf0ca09bb91a3765da068cc19.png] 

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fefe67b91e09a0d2ad1021ec8729aa124766cfb07e9de4307b013f971524a3c3.png] 

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de84430e5bdd8f0db443beb39f0a9134c2f04679e4a20f5815330df91ed5ddfe.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".**
